fieldData.description: Build a supply request form that checks each request against a budget, routes it for approval, and saves it to a database you own.
fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
At $516, it needs Clementine's approval by email

Tavish Moffatt runs a 6-person crew at Henneberg Landscaping. Before spring cleanups he asks for safety vests, pruning shears, and work gloves, a request that totals $516.00. Anything over $500 waits for operations manager Clementine Szabo-Reyes, who approves it from an email. Smaller requests go to the buyer.
